title: 第694章 世界尽头 绝地天通大结局第693章 老魔伏诛
lines: 第694章世界尽头绝地天通（大结局）
距离那场震动整个人间的大战已经过去了一周。
整个人间一片清朗。
人们依旧在狂欢。
即便他们并不清楚究竟发生了什么，但那种莫名的轻松感觉，让每一个人都情不自禁的感觉到欢快。
白家庄里，一片热闹景象。
很多知情者全都聚集在这里，跟小白这些人欢聚一堂。
尼古拉斯大鹅带着厨师帽，挂着可爱的红烧鹅围巾，在给一群来宾演示最正宗的铁锅炖大鹅做法。
“看好了，真正的铁锅炖大鹅，必须要用最原始的铁锅，要用最好的松木，劈成大小均匀的木条。然后这个鹅的处理方式也非常讲究……”
大青狼趴在草坪上晒太阳，充分享受着人间的美好。
血色大蚊子王没在，据说是静极思动，想要回去看看那些徒子徒孙。
同时也想去找啸月老狼聊聊天，毕竟是昔日的对手，如今它境界都这么高深了，总要找人炫耀一下。
那头老狼正适合。
大白虫子蝉爷依然在实验室里面忙碌着，也不知是不是吹牛逼，它说自己根据域外天魔的负能量，已经快要研制出可以毒死红尘仙的毒药。
孙岳琳和孙岳峰难得露面，生意上的事情实在太忙了。
当然，以他们如今的身份地位，也用不着凡事亲力亲为。只是两人都说自己是给小白打工的。
龙傲天那群人也难得露面，他们依然在管理着巨人城试炼场。
跟黑域经常吵得不可开交。
但其实如今黑域也是龙傲天这些人在管理。
自己跟自己吵架，据龙傲天说非常好玩。
夏侯家夏侯明和夏侯紫月也从外地赶回来。
夏侯家在如今的祖龙帝国也相当了不得，生意已经开展到其他文明中去。
所以夏侯明特别忙。
夏侯紫月倒是选择留在飞大当了一名教授。
说起来，于秀秀这群从三仙岛走出来的人，如今也都在飞大当教授。
这所早年不起眼的大学，如今早已成了整个帝国最顶级的学府。
没有之一。
尤其其他文明的年轻人，如果能考到飞大这里，所在的城市都会激动得跟什么似的，不但会给出高额奖金，还会大力宣传。
赵璐如今跟孙岳琳一起，成了孙岳琳的左膀右臂。
在很多方面，她甚至比孙岳琳还要优秀！
但没办法，孙岳琳是小白的姐姐。
所以孙岳琳是老大。
昔年的同学，打比赛的过程中认识的那些朋友，很多都从各地被邀请过来。
老段也从天湖星那边赶过来，嚷嚷着要跟小白单挑喝水。
米线店的郭姐和光哥坐在这群人中间，同样早已成为大人物的他们却有种手都不知往哪放的感觉。
偏偏所有人见到他们，都相当客气！
谁会不客气？
这可是符龙战队崛起之前的老人啊！
那一身资历老的吓死个人！
人事有代谢，往来成古今。
一百几十年的光阴，一个多世纪，对世间凡人来说，已经算是一段漫长岁月。
但对小白这群岁月都无可奈何的人来说，其实也不算什么。
content_en:
Chapter 694: Jedi Tiantong at the End of the World (Grand Finale)
A week has passed since the war that shocked the entire world.
The whole world is clear and clear.
People are still partying.
Even though they didn't know exactly what happened, the inexplicable feeling of relaxation made everyone couldn't help but feel happy.
There was a lively scene in Baijiazhuang.
Many insiders gathered here to have a happy gathering with people like Xiaobai.
Nicholas Goose, wearing a chef's hat and a cute braised goose scarf, was demonstrating the most authentic way to braise goose in an iron pot to a group of guests.
"Look, to really stew a goose in an iron pot, you must use the most original iron pot and the best pine wood, split into evenly sized wood strips. And the way the goose is handled is also very particular..."
The big green wolf lay on the lawn basking in the sun, fully enjoying the beauty of the world.
The big bloody mosquito king is not here. It is said that Jingji is restless and wants to go back and see his disciples.
At the same time, I also wanted to chat with Xiaoyue Old Wolf. After all, he was his former rival. Now that he has reached such a high level, he always needs someone to show off to.
That old wolf fits the bill.
The big white insect Cicada is still busy in the laboratory. I don’t know if he is bragging. He said that based on the negative energy of the demon outside the territory, he has almost developed a poison that can poison the Red Dust Fairy.
Sun Yuelin and Sun Yuefeng rarely showed up because they were too busy with business matters.
Of course, with their current status, they don't need to do everything themselves. But both of them said that they were working for Xiaobai.
Long Aotian and his group also rarely show up. They are still managing the Giant City Proving Ground.
He and Heiyu often had a lot of quarrels.
But in fact, the Black Domain is now managed by people like Long Aotian.
Arguing with yourself is very fun, according to Long Aotian.
Xiahou Ming and Xiahou Ziyue of the Xiahou family also rushed back from other places.
The Xiahou family is also quite prominent in today's Zulong Empire, and its business has expanded to other civilizations.
So Xia Houming is very busy.
Xiahou Ziyue chose to stay at Feida and became a professor.
Speaking of which, people like Yu Xiuxiu who came out of Sanxian Island are now professors at Fei University.
This humble university in its early years has now become the top institution in the entire empire.
Not one.
Especially young people from other civilizations, if they can get admitted to Feida, the city where they live will be as excited as anything. Not only will they give out high bonuses, but they will also vigorously publicize it.
Zhao Lu now, together with Sun Yuelin, has become Sun Yuelin's right-hand man.
In many aspects, she is even better than Sun Yuelin!
But there is no way, Sun Yuelin is Xiaobai's sister.
So Sun Yuelin is the boss.
Many of my former classmates and friends I met during the competition were invited from all over the world.
Lao Duan also rushed over from Tianhu Star, clamoring to challenge Xiao Bai for a drink of water.
Sister Guo and Brother Guang from the rice noodle shop were sitting among this group of people. They had already become important figures, but they felt like they didn't know where to put their hands.
But everyone was quite polite when they saw them!
Who would be rude?
This is the old man before the rise of Fulong Team!
That person with such seniority scares me to death!
People and affairs undergo metabolism, and exchanges become ancient and modern.
More than a hundred years, more than a century, is already a long time for ordinary people in the world.
But for people like Xiaobai who have been helpless for many years, it is actually nothing.
title_en: Chapter 694: The End of the World, The Finale of Jedi Heavenly Tong, Chapter 693: The Old Demon’s Punishment
